category: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets (01)
subcategory_text: Actively manage all enterprise assets connected to the infrastructure physically, virtually, or remotely, including those in cloud and remote environments, and ensure only authorised assets are granted access.
implementation_examples: IG1: Maintain an inventory of enterprise assets; address unauthorised assets
LG2: Use active discovery tools; use DHCP logging; maintain address inventory
IG3: Use agent-based discovery; employ passive discovery
assessment_objectives: Determine whether all enterprise assets are inventoried.
Determine whether unauthorised assets are addressed.
